primary_interest: BMI association conditional on glucose, age and sex; all other relationships and conflicts retained.
population: Community-dwelling Chinese adults, age35-74, both sexes, around2009; complete BMI, age, sex, central serum glucose and HbA1c measurements; no diabetes/treatment exclusions. This describes a selected analytical population, not national representation.
measurements: HbA1c percent, BMI kg/m^2, ageyears, female0/1, central serum glucose mmol/L. Individual fasting adherence not verified; no contamination rate given.
autonomy: Agent chooses queries, original studies, follow-up and quantitative/qualitative applicability decisions; no preferred direction, coefficient or probability family supplied.
routes: Use fixed task-bound literature gateway when suitable; primary publisher, PubMed/PMC, official institutional author repositories and original supplements via web are allowed alternatives for availability gaps. No account, payment or access-control bypass.
source_exclusion: No CHNS-derived numerical evidence. Record overlaps, exclusions and incidental target exposure. Do not use another route to evade a cohort-exclusion rejection.
originals: Track source URL/version/locator, population/selection, units/transforms, exact adjustment set, effect type, point/uncertainty, applicability and unresolved assumptions. Web-rendered originals are inspected evidence but not a fabricated gateway approval; record separately for reviewer admission.
ownership: Fresh host-dispatched acquisition Agent; procedural context boundaries, no OS isolation of all tools. Independent reviewer checks selected originals after acquisition.
stop: Stop after <=5 serious original studies or query/access budget; deliver usable constraints, partial leads, unresolved gaps and stop reason. No fixed paper list and no obligation to find a favorable coefficient.
stage: retrieval_and_audit_only; old candidates/results stay closed; no new generation specification or model change in this unit
